# Sunny Day Family

> > A comprehensive resource for busy families seeking practical organizing tips, parenting advice, DIY projects, and creative activities for kids and pets.

Sunny Day Family is a mom-focused blog created by Laura that combines home organization strategies, family planning resources, and creative activities. The site features printable checklists, seasonal crafts, and practical advice for managing family life, with a strong emphasis on the KonMari decluttering method and family-friendly DIY projects.

## Key Topics

- Home Organization
- Parenting Tips
- Kids Activities
- Printables
- KonMari Method
- Decluttering
- Family Planning
- Seasonal Crafts
- Summer Schedule
- Marie Kondo
- Cricut Projects
- Pet Care
- Cleaning Tips
- Free Resources
- Mom Blogger

## Core Pages

- [Sunny Day Family](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com): Homepage for Sunny Day Family by Laura with organizing tips and mom life hacks.
- [Get Organized](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/p/get-organized.html): Main resource hub for home organization, family planning, and cleaning tips.
- [Family Life](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/p/moms-kids.html): Central collection of parenting tips, kids activities, and family life content.
- [About Laura](http://www.sunnydayfamily.com/p/about-me.html): About page introducing Laura, the author and mom blogger behind Sunny Day Family.

## Home & DIY

- [DIY & Home](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/p/diy-home.html): DIY projects, home decor, and Cricut ideas for family home improvement.
- [5 Things To Do Every Day to Keep Your House Clean and Organized](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2015/04/5-clean-house.html): Daily house cleaning checklist with 5 tasks to keep homes organized for busy families.
- [7 Things Marie Kondo Says To Do Every Day | Free Printable Konmari Checklist](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2019/01/printable-konmari-checklist.html): Daily to-do list inspired by Marie Kondo's KonMari method with free printable checklist.
- [50 Things to Declutter in 15 Minutes a Day | Free Printable List](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2019/01/list-of-things-to-declutter.html): Printable list of 50 quick decluttering tasks inspired by KonMari method.

## Kids Activities & Learning

- [How to Create a Summer Schedule for Kids at Home](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2019/05/creating-a-summer-schedule-for-kids.html): Guide to creating summer schedules for kids with free printable checklist.
- [The Ultimate Guide to Summer Reading Programs for Kids](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2017/07/summer-reading-log.html): Comprehensive guide to summer reading programs for kids with printable resources.
- [12 Educational Podcasts Kids (and Adults!) Will Love](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2025/06/educational-podcasts-for-kids.html): Curated list of 12 educational podcasts like Who Smarted? and Brains On! for families.
- [Make Your Own Book for Kids | Free Printable](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2017/02/make-your-own-book-for-kids.html): Free printable template for kids to create their own DIY books with creative writing.

## Holidays & Seasonal Crafts

- [Holidays & Celebrations](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/p/holidays-celebrations.html): Year-round holiday planning, celebrations, and special occasion family activities.
- [St. Patrick's Day Scavenger Hunt for Kids | Printable](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2017/02/st-patricks-day-scavenger-hunt.html): Printable St. Patrick's Day scavenger hunt activity for kids to find leprechaun's pot of gold.
- [Free Printable Thank You Cards for Kids to Color & Send](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2017/01/printable-thank-you-cards-for-kids.html): Free printable thank you cards for kids to color and send for any occasion.
- [Shake It Up Hearts: No Mess Valentine Craft for Preschoolers](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2016/01/shake-up-hearts.html): No-mess Valentine craft activity for preschoolers and toddlers to create cards.

## Pets

- [Pets](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/p/pets.html): Pet care tips, pet-themed activities, and organizing with pets featuring Griffey, Grady, Biggie.
- [Easy Homemade Dog Donuts Your Pup Will Go Crazy For](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2017/01/dog-donuts.html): Homemade dog donut recipe with yogurt frosting and bacon sprinkles for pets.
